desc:
Developed for the personal use of Char Aznable, the leader of the revived Neo Zeon, this prototype mobile suit for Newtypes was the culmination of all Zeon mobile suit research and development.
It was therefore a true symbol of the reborn Neo Zeon forces.
This machine greedily incorporates concepts from various machines of the Gryps Conflict era.
Though gigantic compared to other MS, it boasts high mobility and operating time thanks to its propellant tanks and movable vernier binders, which double as funnel pods.
It also has the flexibility to adapt to anti-MS combat.
It has incredible responsiveness due to its partial use of Psycho-Frame, a material that incorporates computer chips with basic psycommu functionality.
It is armed with a large mega beam rifle that can fire both focused and diffuse beams, and five funnels in each of its funnel pods.
This remarkable machine has an unusually high level of balance.

character.desc:
Supreme leader of the reborn Neo Zeon forces. He is an ace pilot also known as the "Red Comet."
He is the son of the Zeon founder Zeon Zum Deikun, and plans to purge the people who have remained behind to contaminate the Earth, thus forcing humanity to reform into Newtypes.
During the Gryps Conflict, he fought under the name Quattro Bajeena and tried to reform humanity.
But after seeing how corrupt the Federation government and the other people of Earth were, he decided to take drastic action, reviving Neo Zeon and planning Earth's destruction by freezing it with a nuclear winter.
He has a long history with his arch-nemesis, Londo Bell ace pilot Amuro Ray, but he hopes that this war will put an end to their rivalry.

series.desc:
A theatrical release planned and produced by Sunrise, directed by Yoshiyuki Tomino, and premiered on March 12th, 1988. 
This work depicts the final battle between fated rivals Amuro Ray and Char Aznable.
In December 1987, Tokuma Shoten released the novel "Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack." On February 20th, 1988, Kadokawa Shoten released "Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack - Beltorchika's Children."
